project: Dr Plant multi-crop PlantVillage baseline v1
limitations: Balanced subset: 50 source-train and 20 source-test images per class; not full-dataset training.
CPU-only fast baseline: feature extractor frozen; only final classification layer trained.
Metrics are not field validation and do not estimate accuracy on Syrian farms.
Dataset labels may not be laboratory-confirmed pathogens; expert label review remains required.
Review dataset license and model-derivative obligations before commercial distribution.
